claims.claim: Brookhaven RP has 89,859,852,974 lifetime visits (89.9 billion), verified at build time on Nov 27, 2026.
claims.notes: Official Roblox Games API, universeId 1686885941, rootPlaceId 4924922222. Visits ticked up slightly between two reads the same evening (89,859,795,259 then 89,859,852,974) — still 89.9 billion.

claims.claim: Brookhaven RP is the most visited Roblox game ever: 89.86 billion visits vs 74.58 billion for the next game, Steal a Brainrot (Blox Fruits 65.69B, Adopt Me! 45.52B, Grow a Garden 36.03B).
claims.notes: Same API batch read of the five most-visited games (Nov 22, 2026 factory Top 5 research had the same ranking at 89.7B vs 74.5B). Margin over #2 is ~15.3 billion visits.

claims.claim: Brookhaven RP was created on April 21, 2020.
claims.notes: Official Roblox Games API 'created' field. The narration says 'April 2020' — month precision.

claims.claim: 505,268 players were online in Brookhaven RP at verification on Nov 27, 2026.
claims.notes: Official Roblox Games API 'playing' field. The narration says 'over 500,000 players are exploring its town' — rounded down from the verified 505,268.

claims.claim: Brookhaven RP is run by the group 'Brookhaven by Voldex'.
claims.notes: Official Roblox Games API 'creator' field (type Group). The Nov 22, 2026 factory Top 5 research notes the game was created by Wolfpaq; the current owner group is Voldex. Not narrated — context only.

claims.claim: 31,204,918 players have favorited Brookhaven RP (31.2 million).
claims.notes: Official Roblox Games API 'favoritedCount' field. The narration says '31 million players picked it as their favorite' — favoriting the game.

claims.claim: In Brookhaven RP you pick a house, drive cars, and roleplay any role — the game itself lists student, parent and police officer as examples.
claims.notes: Official game description (Games API): 'Own Houses', 'Drive Cars', 'Roleplay Your Story - Be a student, parent, police officer, or anything you imagine.'

claims.claim: Club Brooks, Brookhaven's nightclub, is open now with a new look (DJ outfit and job, party feature, VIP area, dance emotes).
claims.notes: Official game description (Games API): 'Club Brooks is now open every night with a brand new look! New DJ Outfit & Job, Tool, Party Feature, VIP area & Dance Emotes!' Game record updated Nov 27, 2026.
